brief: Crews must prioritize addressing the active oil issue on Willow Vale before the heat event begins, as work on oil leaks ranks in category 3 of pre-event defect priorities under SOP-016. If this category 4 equivalent defect cannot be completed before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure as directed by MG-023. The supplied documents do not cover any additional actions for this ONAN-cooled asset.
